item.anime_multiverse.sigil_of_rebirth.t: Be reborn: your grimoire(s), their pages and magic types are erased.
Right-click to be warned, then sneak + right-click within the time limit. You keep your race, EP and every skill that is not a grimoire's. A fresh Grimoire Summons follows.
item.anime_multiverse.sigil_of_the_secon: Like Yuno, ask for a second grimoire beside your first.
Needs a four-leaf grimoire or better and one book only. Right-click to be warned, then sneak + right-click. Your first book stays; the Tower Wizard's questions pick a different magic for the second.
